name: zipper
title: Zipper
description: A zip runs down the screen, catching twice before it runs, seals the page behind it, then the two halves fall open sideways. GSAP.
docs:
Wrap your layout with the transition. This is the only step:

  // app/layout.tsx
  import { ZipperTransition } from "@/components/zipper"

  export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en">
        <body>
          <ZipperTransition>{children}</ZipperTransition>
        </body>
      </html>
    )
  }

Your existing <Link>s are intercepted automatically. Recolour the metal and
tape with --zip-metal-*, --zip-tape and --zip-tape-lo in
components/transitions.css.

Note: browser back/forward is not animated, and the route does not start
loading until the leave phase finishes (~1.5s).
